row.name: Stun Attack
row.effect: Single attack at -2. On hit + dmg (even 0), target rolls HT or Stun 1 turn. Deals half damage (or 0 if stun setting).

levels.name: Stun Attack
levels.effect: Single attack at -2. On hit + dmg (even 0), target rolls HT or Stun 1 turn. Deals half damage (or 0 if stun setting).

levels.name: Stun Attack
levels.effect: Single attack at -1. On hit + dmg, target rolls HT-1 or Stun 1d turns. Deals half damage.

levels.name: Stun Attack
levels.effect: Single attack at no penalty. On hit + dmg, target rolls HT-2 or Stun 1d+1 turns. Deals half damage. Crit: Stun 1d turns + HT roll or Unconscious 1d mins.

levels.name: Stun Attack
levels.effect: Single attack at +1. On hit + dmg, target rolls HT-3 or Stun 1d+2 turns. Deals half damage. Crit: Stun 1d+1 turns + HT roll or Unconscious 1d hours.
